description: Attestation-layer mirror of a setpoint envelope compiled into an attested PLC program: per-setpoint min/max + max rate-of-change. Murakumo optimization proposals land ONLY through these envelopes; out-of-envelope requests are clamped at L1 regardless of upstream layer. Per ADR-2606111000 §3.4.

clampCounterTag.description: PLC tag accumulating envelope-clamp events for silenSeigyoReview

minMilli.description: envelope minimum in 1/1000 of unit (implied milli-units; e.g. 250.0 degC = 250000)

maxMilli.description: envelope maximum in 1/1000 of unit (implied milli-units)

maxRateOfChangeMilli.description: max rate of change in 1/1000 of rateUnit (implied milli-units)

rationale.description: why these bounds; note the operational-vs-safety distinction (safety bound is hardwired L1S, not this envelope)
